Harness hazard found and fixed (scratch only, not the repository): /legion/scratch/harness/setup.sh checked the shared Postgres with pg_ctl status, which cannot see a server started from another role's PID namespace; a second start overwrote and then deleted its postmaster.pid and the running server shut itself down a minute later. My setup run did this to the idle implementer's server at 05:04Z; the database files are intact and the server was restarted. setup.sh now asks pg_isready on the shared port instead, and a re-run with the server up left it accepting connections. The server now runs in the tester container's PID namespace.
